title: Claude Code: Customize your status line
summary: The status line runs a script that gets JSON session data on stdin (model, workspace, cost, context window, rate limits and more) and prints what to show, in a row above the footer. It updates on events, debounced at 300 ms, and on an optional refreshInterval of at least one second. Multi-line output, colours and OSC 8 links are allowed. A mod can also set a status entry with $.ui.status.
ideas: One line, always visible, is enough for 'what waits for you'.
refreshInterval keeps the line current while the session is idle.
It shows text and links only; nothing to press beyond a link.
